Class BatteryUseMessage

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.common.messages.flight.cardActions.BatteryUseMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardActionMessage, GameMessage
public class BatteryUseMessage extends Object implements CardActionMessage
A message representing a player's decision to use a specific battery tile to activate or enhance the effect of a BatteryHandlerCard.

This message is typically sent during the resolution of a card that offers the player the choice to consume a battery for an additional effect or action.

The batteryCoords field indicates the coordinates of the battery tile on the player's ship grid that is being used.

Implements CardActionMessage and integrates with the game's message dispatch and card-effect system.
